notes: Six web searches ran; none was refused. None of the search results mentioned Berman in connection with AI. Campaign site is https://www.bermanforcongress.com/ (found via BallotReady); mitchellberman.com belongs to an unrelated Arizona realtor. The undated campaign Priorities page (https://www.bermanforcongress.com/priorities) says, about data centers, "Ending tax breaks for data centers and holding them accountable so they don't drive up the cost of energy and water." It does not mention AI, so it is not recorded as an AI statement; a reviewer could treat it as a D-level remark if data centers are counted as AI. A Wisconsin Public Radio article (22 October 2026, https://www.wpr.org/news/1st-house-district-bryan-steil-mitchell-berman-2026) says he fielded town hall questions about data centers but does not report his answer. Profile articles (Yahoo, 12 August 2025) list affordability, health care and child care as his priorities, with no AI mention. As a first-time candidate he sponsored no bills and signed no House letters; the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act does not apply. Debates and candidate questionnaires were not individually checked beyond these searches, so the search may be incomplete.
